_about: Public-domain Paolo Segneri (1624-1694, Jesuit preacher) in English for the Word Hoard: 10 volumes from Internet Archive scans: The Penitent Instructed (1703), James Ford's three series of sermons from the Quaresimale (1857-1860), The Devout Client of Mary (1857), the Lenten Sermons (vol. II), Sentimenti, or Lights in Prayer (1876), the Panegyrics, tr. William Humphrey (1877), and The Manna of the Soul (2 vols, 1892). Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 30 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

segneri-quaresimale-1: Twelve Sermons from the Quaresimale, tr. James Ford (London: Joseph Masters, MDCCCLVII)
segneri-quaresimale-2: Twelve Sermons from the Quaresimale, second series, tr. James Ford (London: Joseph Masters, MDCCCLIX)
segneri-quaresimale-3: Thirteen Sermons from the Quaresimale, third and concluding series, tr. James Ford (London: Joseph Masters, MDCCCLX)
segneri-devout-client-of-mary: The Devout Client of Mary, translated from the Orvieto edition of 1851 (London: Burns & Lambert, MDCCCLVII)
segneri-lenten-sermons-2: Lenten Sermons, vol. II (New York: Christian Press Association; entered 1874)
segneri-sentimenti: Father Segneri's Sentimenti; or, Lights in Prayer, preface by P. Gallwey (London: Burns and Oates, 1876)
segneri-panegyrics: The Panegyrics of Father Segneri, tr. William Humphrey (London: R. Washbourne, 1877)
segneri-manna-of-the-soul-1: The Manna of the Soul, second edition, vol. I (New York: Benziger, 1892)
segneri-manna-of-the-soul-2: The Manna of the Soul, second edition, vol. II (New York: Benziger, 1892)
